review.assessment: The change introduces a new module, `subs/prorate.py`, intended to calculate prorated refunds, but it implements the logic using a hardcoded constant for month length instead of actual calendar days. By defaulting every month to 30 days (`DAYS_IN_MONTH = 30`), the code ignores the requirement to handle shorter months like February correctly (e.g., refunding $19.28 instead of $20.00). This results in over-refunding for any customer cancelling during a non-30-day month.

findings.defect: Incorrect denominator logic for non-30-day months
